name: Ops
author: gradiscp
description: What needs attention: git repos with uncommitted or unpushed work, recurring chores that are due, and failing homelab checks. A click on a repo opens a terminal there, on a chore runs it in a terminal.

barWidget.description: Checklist icon that is dim while every repo is clean and pushed, bright while work is open, and in the bar's urgent colour once unpushed commits are older than a day; a click opens the panel.
